title: Harvest and Winter
author: Felix Iversen
blurb: Tamsin Iversen, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must return what was taken in 1974 before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
